title: The Quiet about the Burnt Toast
youtube_title: The Quiet about the Burnt Toast | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Hiding a dent does not make the dent untrue.
summary: At a kitchen table with jam, butter, and a shared pencil tin, Cosima is tangled up with a toast burned and scraped and almost served without a word and almost hides it. Cosima tells Ms. Okonkwo the plain truth, and together they mend what can be mended, with no teasing.
